blurb: **Hyperliquid perps, EU sanctions, NYDFS stablecoin rules, and $77.6B in spot BTC ETF assets signal a shifting crypto landscape.**
title: Crypto Trading Signals - June 10, 2026
top_story_headline: Hyperliquid perps launch on Nansen raises questions about leverage risks
top_story_comment: $6.7B in 24h notional on Hyperliquid with 40x BTC and 25x ETH leverage is already enough firepower without dropping the trade button inside Nansen’s whale-watching UI. Pairing Smart Money labels with one-click perps compresses the whole copy-trade loop, so crowded wallet flows can flip from alpha feed to liquidation fuel fast. In a flush, everyone staring at the same “smart” address is just correlated leverage with better branding.
